whyMatters.en: Reykjavík band that put bowed guitar, falsetto, and Hopelandic vocals into post-rock crossover; Takk… (2005) and Hoppípolla widened the audience.
whyMatters.zh: 雷克雅未克乐队：把弓奏吉他、假声与 Hopelandic 人声送进 post-rock 跨界；Takk…（2005）与 Hoppípolla 扩大听众。

shortBio.en: Icelandic post-rock; Hoppípolla is the accessible Takk… single.
shortBio.zh: 冰岛 post-rock；Hoppípolla 是易入口 Takk… 单曲。

body.en:
Formed 1994 in Reykjavík. Ágætis byrjun (1999) and ( ) established Jónsi’s falsetto, bowed guitar, and orchestral builds; Takk… (2005) added clearer melodic singles.

Hoppípolla (2005) is the chart/licensing entry. They sit with Mogwai/Godspeed on the instrumental crescendo map but keep vocal melody and Hopelandic language as primary carriers.
body.zh:
1994 年于雷克雅未克组建。Ágætis byrjun（1999）与 ( ) 确立 Jónsi 假声、弓奏吉他与管弦渐强；Takk…（2005）加入更清晰的旋律单曲。

Hoppípolla（2005）是榜单/授权入口。与 Mogwai/Godspeed 同在器乐 crescendo 地图，但以人声旋律与 Hopelandic 语言为主要载体。

note.en: Brass and piano hook—Takk… single for chart and licensing entry.
note.zh: 铜管与钢琴钩子——Takk… 榜单与授权入口单曲。

note.en: Bow-played guitar and 延音 swell—Ágætis byrjun post-rock grammar.
note.zh: 弓奏吉他与 延音 swell——Ágætis byrjun post-rock 语法。

note.en: Slow build to full-band crescendo—Takk… live set centerpiece.
note.zh: 慢建到全乐队 crescendo——Takk… 现场组曲核心。

body.en:
Sigur Rós matter for merging bowed guitar, reverb-drenched 延音, and Jónsi’s falsetto into post-rock that still reads as song.

Ágætis byrjun (1999) and ( ) (2002) use Hopelandic/non-lexical vocals as texture.

Takk… (2005) adds brass and clearer hooks—Hoppípolla becomes licensing staple.

They widen post-rock beyond wordless crescendo bands.
body.zh:
Sigur Rós 要紧处是把弓奏吉他、混响 延音 与 Jónsi 假声合并成仍可读作歌曲的 post-rock。

Ágætis byrjun（1999）与 ( )（2002）用 Hopelandic/非词汇人声作质感。

Takk…（2005）加铜管与更清晰钩子——Hoppípolla 成授权常备。

把 post-rock 扩至非仅无人声 crescendo 乐队。

body.en:
1994–2012 core live unit: Jónsi, Georg Hólmar, Orri, Kjartan—bow guitar, bass, drums, keys/ brass arrangements.

Kjartan’s departure 2012 reduces on-stage keyboard/brass; later tours use expanded ensembles.

Jónsi’s bow technique and falsetto remain the constant sonic ID across roster tweaks.

Icelandic studio conditions and long reverb tails are part of the production document.
body.zh:
1994–2012 核心现场单元：Jónsi、Georg Hólmar、Orri、Kjartan——弓吉他、贝斯、鼓、键盘/铜管编配。

Kjartan 2012 年离队减少台上键盘/铜管；后期巡演用扩展编制。

Jónsi 弓技法与假声经阵容微调保持恒定声音 ID。

冰岛录音条件与长混响尾是制作文献的一部分。

title.en: Vocal post-rock for film and charts
title.zh: 影视与榜单的人声 post-rock

body.en:
Sigur Rós proved post-rock could carry melody and language—not only Mogwai-style instrumentals.

My Bloody Valentine’s textural guitar and Radiohead’s ambient turns are audible ancestors.

Hoppípolla and Svefn-g-englar remain sync-licensing references.

Later records split critical reception but Takk…/Ágætis era is the citation core.
body.zh:
Sigur Rós 证明 post-rock 可承载旋律与语言——非仅 Mogwai 式器乐。

My Bloody Valentine 质感吉他与 Radiohead ambient 转向是可闻祖先。

Hoppípolla 与 Svefn-g-englar 仍是同步授权引用。

后期唱片评论分裂，Takk…/Ágætis 时期是引用核心。
